title: An approved spender takes the rewards when it renews a position
rootCause: MlumStaking._lockPosition harvests to msg.sender, and renewLockPosition allows an approved account, so a spender who renews a position collects what the position earned instead of its owner.

poc.observable: test_rewards_stay_with_the_owner_when_a_spender_renews fails with "the spender keeps none of the rewards: 99999999999 != 0"
